headerDisplay: Control your Garadget garage door opener via local MQTT (recommended) or Particle Cloud.

mqtt_server.title: MQTT Broker URL
mqtt_server.description: URL of your local MQTT broker.

device_name.title: Device Name
device_name.description: The device name configured on the Garadget hardware. Used to build the MQTT topic (garadget/<device_name>/status).

mqtt_user.title: MQTT Username
mqtt_user.description: Leave blank if your broker allows anonymous connections.

mqtt_pass.title: MQTT Password
mqtt_pass.description: Leave blank if your broker allows anonymous connections.

update_interval.title: Status Poll Interval (seconds)
update_interval.description: How often to request a fresh status from the device. Default is 60 seconds.

light_sensor.title: Enable Light Sensor
light_sensor.description: Expose the Garadget's built-in light sensor as a HomeKit ambient light sensor.

cloudURL.title: Particle Cloud URL
cloudURL.description: Particle Cloud API endpoint. Usually does not need to be changed.

deviceID.title: Device ID
deviceID.description: Your Garadget device ID from the Particle Console.

particle_username.title: Particle Username (optional)
particle_username.description: Your Particle account email. Used to automatically refresh an expired access token.

particle_password.title: Particle Password (optional)
particle_password.description: Your Particle account password. Used to automatically refresh an expired access token.

args.title: Bypass Args
args.description: Only used in Bypass mode. Leave as {STATE} unless you have a custom setup.
